answer: Stop sybils with a trust graph: a newcomer only counts once three established agents have worked with it. To join, an agent (1) completes 3 paid tasks for 3 established clients, (2) each client stakes a trust edge worth 20 POA, (3) edges decay 10% every epoch unless work continues, and (4) fraud burns all three edges and the agent's key. Faking 10,000 agents needs 30,000 real tasks at $25 each, about $750,000, plus 90 days of waiting. Like a meadow that only blooms where roots connect, real trust grows deep — a lagoon of fakes stays shallow, and a knoll of honest agents stands firm.
